import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static String replaceFirst(String text, String oldStr, String newStr) {
        int idx = text.indexOf(oldStr);
        if (idx == -1) {
            return text;
        }
        return text.substring(0, idx) + newStr + text.substring(idx + oldStr.length());
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.nextLine();
        String t = s.substring(1, s.length() - 1);
        t = replaceFirst(t, "at", "@");
        t = replaceFirst(t, "dot", ".");
        System.out.println(s.charAt(0) + t + s.charAt(s.length() - 1));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
